description: Patrols of 7 client sites from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m.; checkpoint scans; GPS tracking; observations recorded in the patrol app
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: One missed night costs about $580 plus contract credits, and two in a row put contracts at risk; the patrol must be ready before the next 10 p.m. shift; RPO set by the patrol app's sync and the vendor's 1-hour RPO
manual_workaround: Paper patrol log with time-stamped phone photos entered in the app after recovery; backup agency covers a night the owner cannot work (verbal arrangement today)
dependent_third_parties: Patrol app vendor; mobile carrier; backup patrol agency
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure); patrol vehicle; client keys

description: Alarm company and client calls at any hour for 4 clients; travel to site within 45 minutes; open the site with client keys and codes; call 911 when needed
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contracts require arrival within 45 minutes; an unanswered alarm can mean fire, flood, or intrusion damage and harm to people on site; the access code list must be no more than one day old
manual_workaround: Alarm company calls the next keyholder or police; owner reads codes from the sealed paper code book in the home safe (from 2026-09-15); backup agency once it holds keys and codes under a written agreement
dependent_systems: SYS-05; SYS-02 (code spreadsheet until replaced); SYS-01 (post orders)
dependent_third_parties: Alarm monitoring companies; mobile carrier; backup patrol agency
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure); client keys and access cards; patrol vehicle

description: Daily activity reports by 6:30 a.m.; incident reports within 24 hours; immediate phone call for urgent events; client portal; email with clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients need urgent events at once and routine reports each morning; accurate reports are a licensing duty (Fla. Stat. 493.6119(4)); reports are evidence for clients, insurers, and police
manual_workaround: Phone calls and texts with no codes or personal information; reports written in the app from the phone; email from the phone if the laptop is down
dependent_third_parties: Patrol app vendor (and its AI model provider); email provider

description: Monthly invoices and ACH payment links from the accounting SaaS; payment follow-up
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $15,000 invoiced a month; clients pay within 30 days, so a week's delay affects cash flow only
manual_workaround: Invoice from the accounting SaaS web portal on the phone; paper invoices if needed; personal savings cover about 6 weeks of expenses

description: Producing records to the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services on request; license renewals; insurance certificates and claim notices; contracts and post orders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Records must be kept 2 years and made available to the Department immediately on request (Fla. Stat. 493.6121(2)); inability to produce them is a licensing issue
manual_workaround: Patrol app exports and paper key log; contracts re-requested from clients; license and insurance documents in paper copies at the home office
dependent_third_parties: Patrol app vendor; email and file provider; insurance agent
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner; home office (principal place of business)
